subject: Re: [AMBER] [EXTERNAL] Calculation of RDF around a fixed position in space

messages.author: Roe, Daniel \(NIH/NHLBI\) \[E\]
messages.body:
Hi,
I just added this feature to the GitHub (
https://github.com/Amber-MD/cpptraj
) version of cpptraj (version 6.8.1) via the new keyword 'toxyz <x>,<y>,<z>'.  So for example to calculate the RDF for water after recentering the system on the origin (0, 0, 0):
parm ../tz2.truncoct.parm7
trajin ../tz2.truncoct.nc
autoimage origin
radial out wat.origin.agr 0.25 15.0 :WAT.O toxyz 0,0,0
Hope this helps,
-Dan

Dear AMBER community,
I want to calculate the RDF around a fixed point in space other than atoms.
Is there any option available in CPPTRAJ to do this?
I would be very thankful for any help.
